caption: The drawing features a rectangular design with rounded corners, bordered by a thick frame consisting of green, dark green, brown, and cream swirls and floral embellishments. Inside the frame, the interior background is a light, muted gray color. In the center, there is a bouquet-like arrangement of colorful flowers, each composed of clusters of small, petal-like shapes. The flowers are different colors, with two large red flowers, one smaller pink flower, a purple flower, two orange flowers, and one smaller blue flower, each with a yellow or contrasting color in their centers. The bouquet is accompanied by clusters of green leaves at the base and among the flowers. The texture throughout is rendered as small, cell-like segments, imitating the appearance of a hooked rug or mosaic. There are signatures and writing below the drawing, including the text: "A2115 - 7 - A" on the left and "Ruth M. Barnes" on the right.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
